note: Authoritative field boundary. Consumed by scripts/gen_boustrophedon.py (mission) and scripts/gen_farm_world.py (Gazebo world) so both stay geometrically consistent -- if you change this polygon, regenerate BOTH config/missions/boustrophedon.waypoints and sim/worlds/farmguard_field.sdf, or the mission will no longer sweep the world you're flying it in.
coordinate_frame: local ENU meters (x=East, y=North, z=Up) relative to (home_lat, home_lon); origin (0,0) = SITL home = drone spawn point = SW corner of the field. Same ENU convention documented in sim/spike/README.md for the NDVI spike.
polygon_note: Rectangle currently swept by config/missions/boustrophedon.waypoints: 6 lanes x 15m spacing = 75m east extent, 60m north extent (scripts/gen_boustrophedon.py --width 80 --height 60 --spacing 15 --alt 15 -- the generator's internal lane math yields 75m, not the nominal 80m 'width' argument; see that script's boustrophedon_latlon()).
